---
title: "Mount Holyoke College"
---

Founded: 1837 as a seminary, 1888 as a college

Location: South Hadley, Massachusetts

Motto: That our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace. - Psalms 144:12

Student Newspaper Name: At certain points, it is called alternatively The Mount Holyoke News or Choragos

Fun fact: Mount Holyoke was the first of the Seven Sisters to admit transgender students.
